purpose: Compile the frozen MLP4-to-attention5 causal path and its explicitly bounded downstream observations into one hash-bound typed program artifact, preserving prospective evidence, prices, dependencies, and negative scope.

predictions.pred_a_hash_bound_authority: The artifact and all six evidence receipts retain their reviewed byte hashes and recorded terminal states.
predictions.pred_b_typed_graph_exact: The artifact contains the two-term MLP4 equation, three write/source positions, attention5 heads H7/H1/H6/H8, the resid5-to-resid9 carried curve, and the discovery-only attention9 H1/H4 branch.
predictions.pred_c_discovery_metrics_exact: Every compiled discovery metric exactly equals its immutable authority field, including the null-terminal onset and H1/H4 tests.
predictions.pred_d_prospective_metrics_exact: The sealed lexical/recombination holdout remains a screen and exactly supports the compiled writer, four-head, three-source-bank, direction, and all-head-retention fields.
predictions.pred_e_price_dependency_scope_exact: The artifact stores no fitted scalars or vectors, requires checkpoint weights and paired base/donor states, and explicitly excludes standalone native margins, full logits, free-form text, new constructions, and whole-model replacement.

terminal.release: All five hash, graph, metric, price, dependency, and scope predictions pass.
terminal.invalid: Any immutable hash, terminal, graph field, metric, price, dependency, or scope check fails.
